newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah falls, swaps down in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah falls, swaps down in choppy trade.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell against the dollar after soaring earlier on rumours that Malaysian authorities would scrap swap facilities, dealers said.
Swap points also softened after an early jump, they said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,432.0/33.0 against the dollar at 0210 GMT after rising to an early high of 2,413.0 on offshore fears that the Indonesian central bank could follow suit on swap facilities.
"This follows early talk in the market that the Malaysian monetary authority was considering such a move," one local bank dealer said, adding that this could not be confirmed.
Dealers said the offshore jitters resulted from moves by the Thai monetary authority on Thursday to stop quoting tomorrow/next swaps to offshore players.
They said panic swamped the market, driving tomorrow/next to a high of 7.0 points, equivalent to about 100 percent, before they fell to 1.0/2.0 at 0210 GMT.

They said traders also focused on one-month swaps, possibly because of the May 29 general elections. One-month swaps soared to a high of 50 points, equivalent to some 31 percent, before cooling off to 20.0/30.0 later.
